diagnosis: The export-chart route is bound to the Gin engine before AuthenticateTenant middleware is registered. Because middleware registered via r.Use() only applies to routes attached afterward, the medical chart export endpoint does not execute tenant validation or patient verification. Any client can dump confidential clinical charts by patient ID.
exploit_request:
GET /patients/49201/export-chart HTTP/1.1
Host: clinic.healthsync.com
Accept: application/json
